items.title: Roswell Rudd interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: Benny Goodman. Benny Goodman Trio, Benny Goodman Quartet, yeah, I remember those distinctly.

ctx.x: Would his collection include the swing bands, a la Glenn Miller or was that a little too commercial?
Benny Goodman. Benny Goodman Trio, Benny Goodman Quartet, yeah, I remember those distinctly. Yeah those are good.
So you kind of had that swing rhythm become a part of you at a young age.
